description: This file defines the Aldi class, a web scraper for Aldi recipes, inheriting from AbstractScraper. It includes methods to extract recipe details such as author, title, category, times, yields, image, ingredients, and instructions, utilizing BeautifulSoup for HTML parsing.

classes.name: Aldi
classes.description: A web scraper class for Aldi recipes, extending AbstractScraper, with methods to parse recipe details from Aldi's website.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host URL for Aldi's website.

methods.name: site_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the site, 'Aldi'.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Extracts the author meta content from the webpage.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe title from the webpage.

methods.name: category
methods.description: Extracts the recipe category from the webpage.

methods.name: prep_time
methods.description: Calculates preparation time using a regex pattern.

methods.name: cook_time
methods.description: Calculates cooking time using a regex pattern.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Sums prep and cook times to get total time.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Extracts the number of servings or makes from the webpage.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Returns a list of ingredients from the recipe.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Returns the recipe instructions as a string.

methods.name: _get_value
methods.description: Helper method to extract values associated with labels in the webpage.
